name: trading-bot
description: Use Trading Bot to discover, preview, confirm, and execute guarded actions through supported onchain adapters and assigned Privy wallets.

interface.shortDescription: Guarded trading workflows across supported dApps.
interface.longDescription: Trading Bot provides a shared natural-language workflow over supported onchain adapters and assigned Privy wallets. Every state-changing action is validated, simulated, and shown as an immutable short-lived plan. User-requested exact token approvals and approvals required for a requested swap can proceed without another user confirmation. Swaps and other actions require user confirmation or an applicable active Codex Goal before the MCP service queues them for the guarded Executor.
defaultPrompt: Show the onchain projects and actions available to me.
List the markets I can use on LeverUp.
Show whether my Aave, Kuru, or Morpho position can exit immediately.
